name: Prayer of mending
desc: Minor wounds closed by a priest's touch (a cure wounds of the lowest rank).

name: Cure wounds
desc: 1st-level spell: wounds knit while you watch.

name: Healing word
desc: 1st-level spell, spoken from across the room.

name: Lesser restoration
desc: 2nd-level spell: ends a disease, blindness, deafness, paralysis or poison.

name: Remove curse
desc: 3rd-level spell: lifts a curse on a creature or breaks an item's hold.

name: Greater restoration
desc: 5th-level spell (+100 gp of diamond dust): ends charm, petrification, a curse, or a reduced score.

name: Raise dead
desc: 5th-level spell (+ a diamond worth 500 gp, consumed). The body must be fresh and the soul willing.

name: Augury
desc: 2nd-level spell: weal, woe, both or nothing, for a plan in the next half hour.

name: Divination
desc: 4th-level spell (+25 gp of incense): one question, one truthful answer.

name: Blessing of the faithful
desc: A short rite before a journey or a battle.

name: Funeral rites
desc: Prayers, a pyre or a grave, and a name remembered.

name: Wedding
desc: Vows before the gods and the gossips.

name: Sanctuary for the night
desc: A pallet in the cloister; donations welcome.

name: Candle
desc: Lit at the altar for a wish or a memory.

name: Incense
desc: Sweet smoke rises with your prayer.

name: Holy symbol, silver
desc: An amulet or emblem fit for a cleric's focus.

name: Holy water
desc: Blessed at dawn, sealed with wax.
